answer: Sybil farms mint pack identities. Each miner locks a 2400-unit bond in a time-locked vault bound to a unique graph vertex (hash of the first-finalized 7-peer neighborhood). Withdrawals clear only after a 36-hour tundra cooldown with no new sibling sharing the same /24 or device fingerprint. Auditors sample 12 vault receipts per epoch and recompute the vertex hash; mismatch or cooldown breach slashes the bond and freezes that vertex for 3 epochs. If the vault oracle is down 90s, the bond stays locked (fail-closed) and the identity is skipped for that epoch's reward, not accepted unsigned.
